title: Gakkou no Kaidan: Kubinashi Rider!! Shi no Noroi
justification: AniList 102000 (SPECIAL, 1 episode(s) from 2001-08-24) is AniDB 481's special(s) S1, aired 2001-08-24. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 1281, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 481, and the special's title matches an AniList title. On TMDB 35466 the parent's node places the special(s) where TMDB's dates disagree (AniDB S1 aired 2001-08-24, TMDB 35466 S0E1 2000-11-15), so the bridged record publishes no TMDB value.
